content.text:
I fixed what I think is the cause of the crash. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested.

With `LIMIT 0`, `TopNHeap` has `heap_size == 0`. In `TopNHeap::Sink`, `EntryShouldBeAdded` then falls through to `heap.front()` on an empty heap. `AddEntryToHeap` also calls `pop_heap` and `pop_back` on that empty heap. Both are undefined behaviour. Whether it crashes depends on memory state, which would explain why it only failed after about 1000 runs.

The change is in `src/execution/operator/order/physical_top_n.cpp`. `TopNHeap::Sink` now returns immediately when `heap_size == 0`. `PhysicalTopN::GetDataInternal` already returns `FINISHED` when `limit == 0`, so nothing is lost.

I didn't add a regression test.
